description: Central scheme providing income support to small and marginal farmers.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year in three installments directly to bank accounts.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land. Institutional landholders, higher income taxpayers excluded.
required_documents: Aadhaar, land ownership documents, bank account details.
application_process: Register at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or online via pmkisan.gov.in. Verification by local revenue authorities.

description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against natural calamities, pests and diseases.
benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance cover at subsidized premiums (2% kharif, 1.5% rabi, 5% horticulture).
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Loanee farmers compulsory; others voluntary.
required_documents: Aadhaar, land documents, bank account, sowing certificate.
application_process: Contact nearest bank, CSC, or insurance company empanelled under PMFBY. Online via portal.

description: Free soil testing and health cards to farmers with nutrient-based fertilizer recommendations.
benefits: Free soil test every 2 years with customized fertilizer recommendations per plot.
application_process: Visit nearest soil testing lab or contact village agriculture officer.

description: Scheme to expand irrigated area and improve water use efficiency.
benefits: Subsidies for micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler), farm ponds, and water harvesting structures.
eligibility: All farmers; micro-irrigation subsidies vary by state.
required_documents: Land documents, Aadhaar, bank account, quotation for equipment.
application_process: Apply at district agriculture/horticulture office or online state portal.

description: Easy access to short-term credit for cultivation, equipment, and post-harvest needs.
benefits: Collateral-free loan up to Rs 1.6 lakh at 4% effective interest (with subvention). Interest subvention for prompt repayment.
eligibility: All farmers, share croppers, tenant farmers, dairy and fisheries farmers.
required_documents: Land documents, Aadhaar, bank account, KCC application form.
application_process: Apply at your bank branch with land documents. Sanction typically within 2-3 weeks.

description: Promotes natural/organic farming to reduce input costs and improve soil health.
benefits: Financial assistance for training, inputs, and demonstration; up to Rs 19,000/ha over 3 years.
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt natural farming practices; individual and group clusters.
application_process: Apply through state agriculture department or cluster coordinator.
